name: ImportChronologyRecovery
input: staged ImportRun classified CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT or OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED plus current source-family checkpoint
preview: show source family/profile, selected candidate physical provenance, candidate chronology, current checkpoint chronology, both logical fingerprints and exact staged proposal/findings counts
for older source, explicitly state that accepting evidence will not make old file/business facts 'new today' and will not infer omission/lifecycle
compute review_fingerprint over exact run/checkpoint identity + chronology/fingerprints + current proposal material-input fingerprints
equal_chronology_different_content: review may reject the conflicting run, defer it, or authorize it as a source-correction recovery against the same chronology

authorized correction keeps prior observations immutable, applies accepted target proposals through normal owning-domain commands, appends import_recovery_event, and may replace the checkpoint fingerprint at the same chronology only after all accepted recovery work is committed consistently
older_source: review may use the run only as explicit historical/correction evidence and accept individual target proposals through normal stale-safe owning-domain commands
accepted older recovery appends import_recovery_event and run/disposition evidence but never decrements the source-family checkpoint chronology
older recovery therefore cannot cause automatic discovery to treat even older files as new or cause omission inference
a later genuinely newer source still compares against the monotonic highest accepted checkpoint
transaction_rules: each accepted domain proposal remains its own smallest safe UnitOfWork unless an owning-domain invariant requires a bounded atomic group
recovery-event/checkpoint mutation is committed only after the run reaches a consistent reviewed terminal disposition; crash before that leaves current checkpoint unchanged
command receipt precedes recovery rows that reference it
no recovery path bypasses terminal/hierarchy/customer/timeframe/competing-attempt review requirements
idempotency: Replaying the same reviewed recovery command_id/request hash returns the committed recovery result; a second distinct recovery against unchanged exact run/checkpoint is NO_CHANGE or already-disposed rather than duplicate history.
